entries.name: open-item-s2-void-balance
entries.claim: Nothing is owed on a void item: void writes its balance to zero.

kills.name: void: an open item with nothing applied is voided and keeps its number; an applied one is refused
kills.expected: a voided fee note still owes its balance

entries.name: open-item-s2-unapply-state
entries.claim: An unapply moves each item's state from its figures: nothing applied is open again.

kills.name: unapply returns the amounts to both ends; a line is unapplied once, by its own source
kills.expected: a fully unapplied fee note did not return to open

entries.name: open-item-s2-policy-changed
entries.claim: A permission or membership revoked after the gateway decided refuses the money write.

kills.name: named refusals: currency missing, policy changed, isolation, direction mismatch
kills.expected: an issue ran under a policy that moved after the decision

entries.name: open-item-s2-isolation
entries.claim: A grant is consumed only under READ COMMITTED, which the line freeze depends on.
entries.original:
IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'read committed' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'openItem.isolationUnsupported'; END IF;

kills.name: named refusals: currency missing, policy changed, isolation, direction mismatch
kills.expected: a grant was consumed outside READ COMMITTED

entries.name: open-item-s2-currency-missing
entries.claim: Two items with no stored currency never settle each other as one currency.

kills.name: named refusals: currency missing, policy changed, isolation, direction mismatch
kills.expected: a receipt with no stored currency was applied

entries.name: open-item-s2-direction
entries.claim: At run time an amount moves only within one direction, credit side to debit side.

kills.name: named refusals: currency missing, policy changed, isolation, direction mismatch
kills.expected: a receivable item could be settled by a payable item at run time
